description: Legal Affairs Department -  Methodology to Identify Low-income Families for welfare benit payments
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of a new regulatory framework for welfare benefit payments under the Welfare Benefits Act, No. 24 of 2002. It contains a statutory instrument made by the Minister of Finance that outlines detailed criteria, indicators, and calculation methodologies for identifying low-income families. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it concerns regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements established under existing legislation.
